meta.name: Love Sleep Repeat 1080p Zee5 Series
meta.description:
Love, Sleep, Repeat is a ZEE5 Original starring Anshuman Malhotra, Priyal Gor, Raima Sen, Priya Banerjee, Harshadaa Vijay, Teena Singh and Puneesh Sharma. The story revolves around Vishwas who travels to Pune and comes across seven different girls in seven days, who teach him a lesson.

Returning Series · First aired 7 Nov 2019 · India · Language: Hindi

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: What a Duck!
videos.overview: Vishwas finds a job in Pune and is quite excited about moving away from his dominating mother and bossy friend, Shailja. While in Pune, Vishwas is shocked to see his upright cousin Ajay getting high on dope and naughty with women. At a party, Vishwas meets Raina and has a great time after getting high, however, his trip soon comes crashing down to reality.

videos.title: GFT - Girlfriend Tax
videos.overview: A day earlier, while travelling from Panchgani to Pune, Vishwas meets a beautiful girl, Nishika, in the bus. Over the course of the journey, they start enjoying each other’s company and the trip turns out to be an eventful experience for Vishwas.

videos.title: TFW - That Feeling When
videos.overview: Vishwas finds an accommodation in Pune where he falls for the landlord’s beautiful and homely daughter, Vijayanti. A great job and a caring partner are all that Vishwas wanted from life and he feels his dreams have come true. However, Vijayanti’s father is a difficult man to please and Vishwas’s friend devices a plan to impress the old man but a bigger surprise awaits them.

videos.title: YAAS – An Enthusiastic Way of Saying Yes!
videos.overview: In office, Vishwas finds his senior Sanjana to be very supportive. After a stressful week in office his hot colleague Richa suggests a plan to let off all his steam with sex. When things starts looking up for Vishwas, an unexpected surprise awaits him.

videos.title: STAN- Combination of Stalker and Fan
videos.overview: When nothing seems to be going his way, Preet enters Vishwas’ life. He discovers that Preet liked him from day one and her family too has taken a special liking for him. While everything seems to be getting back on track, a new twist occurs in his life.

videos.title: The Struggle is Real, Bro!
videos.overview: While his job was a dream come true, his boss turns out to be nightmare. Vishwas closeness to Sanjana makes him the prime target of the obsessive boss. However, Vishwas proves himself and wins praises at work and for once he seems to be in control of the situation.

videos.title: Last Chance
videos.overview: From his recent experiences Vishwas realises what he wants in life, which he kept refusing to accept for a long time. It’s time to gear up and go after what he needs in life, but first it’s pay-back time for everyone who troubled him.
